description: Expandable swimlane task boards for human + AI collaboration: one self-contained HTML file with lanes per actor, boxes in dependency order, checklists and machine-readable check reports; state lives in GitHub Issues or a local JSON file.
rules: The board is a generated view: update the source of truth (GitHub Issues or state.json) first, then regenerate. Never hand-edit generated HTML.
Read docs/authoring-guide.md before creating or updating a board.
Put only human-only work in human lanes, and give every task a source.
